projects.label: Childcare Culture & Co.
projects.summary: Mark's independent-contractor engagement with Childcare Culture & Co. used the official contracted title GoHighLevel & Systems Specialist. He implemented/refined six responsive GoHighLevel pages with custom HTML/CSS and worked on CRM fields, tags, forms, pipelines, calendars, notifications, follow-ups, and workflow automation. Foundation First work covered a six-phase, 36-question assessment and results infrastructure, including controlled QA of 0–4 scoring, classifications, contact updates, retake cleanup, and workflow logs. He also contributed to Culture Club Community/membership, welcome, and selected subscription-related workflows; Founding Cohort application, acceptance, agreement, assessment, onboarding, and recurring-session processes; 90-Day Experience onboarding components; summit-facing UI and sponsorship workflow structure; and three client-approved promotional reels.
projects.status: Contributions include implemented, collaborative, configured, manually tested, draft, and dependent work. Results pages, result emails, and some advanced follow-up journeys are not established as complete. Selected Culture Club tests do not verify all live payment, cancellation, or subscription lifecycle scenarios. Some 90-Day components depended on approved content and business rules; planned sponsor outreach is not a completed campaign or outcome.
